posts.text: Our media ought to be compelled to preface every article about a politician or party with a line on the donors they represent. What context could be more critical to the public interest?

I mean, I *was* laughing at them for going to Murrow. I was not using the “whoever wrote this” construction to imply the writer is a nobody
I wasn’t insulting the author, I didn’t know about this piece until I saw this post that didn’t name the person who wrote the essay.
One that ends with someone bumming a cigarette
Also, just buy a pack of cigarettes. Not everything needs to be an essay
